async def act(page):
    # Ensure navigation to Catalog page by clicking the link again with exact name match
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Catalog', exact=True).click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait a bit for the page to fully render
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Now, look for a search input or product grid to find 'Taurus Elements Shell'
    # First, check if we are on a product management page by looking for common elements
    search_box = page.get_by_role('searchbox')
    if await search_box.count() > 0:
        # Type the product name to search
        await search_box.fill('Taurus Elements Shell')
        await search_box.press('Enter')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        # If no search box, look for a product grid or link to products
        # For example, click on 'Products' link if available
        products_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Products')
        if await products_link.count() > 0:
            await products_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        else:
            # Fallback: navigate to the products page via URL if known
            await page.goto('/admin/catalog/product/index/')
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
